title: Late Completion Courtesy on Estimate Overage Credits — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Courtesy schedule — Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** The late completion courtesy follows how long a concern line stayed open after its last authorization.

| Calendar days from the latest authorized decision on the line to the day the line's labor closed | Gold or Platinum account | Account at any other tier |
|---|---|---|
| More than 3 | 20.00 added to an overage credit | 10.00 added to an overage credit |
| 3 or fewer | Nothing added | Nothing added |

The day the line's labor closed is the latest line date of the line's labor charges.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Latest authorized decision on 10 June:
- labor closed 13 June — 3 days, nothing added;
- labor closed 14 June — 4 days, 20.00 on a Gold or Platinum account, 10.00 on any other.
